sources.quote: 8.4.2.1 A change of subcontracted process, including surface treatment, needs notification to Stellantis and approval before shipment.
Surface treatment (subcontracted to Anodica Veneta S.r.l.)
BOM-LINE 120: part BR-220 (drawing Rev C); program STL-Torino-27; customer STL

findings.why: BR-220 is on program STL-Torino-27 for Stellantis, which is in Annex A of the CSR. The change moves anodising from Anodica Veneta to Rivestimenti Nord, which is a change of subcontracted surface-treatment process. Clause 8.4.2.1 requires notification and approval before shipment. The change also replaces a sub-supplier, so clause 8.5.6.1 (documented risk analysis and written approval before shipment) probably applies too. No document in force already covers this change or records an approval or notification.
